search_log: Searched “To the Nines Janet Evanovich excerpt first chapter” and publisher/Google Books variants; found and opened the author's official Chapter One excerpt.
Opened the Google Books record, but its accessible landing page supplied catalog and synopsis material rather than usable narrative prose.
Searched “To the Nines” with “first person,” “point of view,” and “narrator”; opened an explicit whole-book first-person description and corroborating series-level discussions.

Searched “To the Nines” with “alternating narrator,” “multiple narrators,” “epistolary,” “diary,” and “frame narrative”; found no credible evidence of a different sustained narrative person or framing structure.
Opened the Macmillan title page and Publishers Weekly-related material; these confirmed the work and Stephanie-centered story but added no stronger whole-book person evidence than the cited sources.
person_note: The controlling narrator is Stephanie Plum. Numerous interior quote passages independently expose her “I”/“my” narration, and the authorized Chapter One excerpt sustains the same voice; a book-specific review also explicitly describes the whole novel as first person from Stephanie's point of view. Third-person references merely describe other characters within Stephanie's account. Dialogue pronouns are local, and q00029's malformed attribution is clipping noise rather than evidence of another narrative strand. Targeted research found no alternating or framed narration. The Tier A source covers only the opening, but the interior quote evidence and whole-book description resolve that scope limitation.
